meta.source: Case Amplify Content Studio kit 0.13.1 (ca-sheet.css, ca-social.css, ca-charts.lua, build-deck.js, build-blog.js, build-sheet.js). Print sizes are pt in the kit; values here are px at 96 dpi.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Ground for every page, slide, post and card. Dark: the dark card, dark posts and dark panels, drawn over the cta-card background image.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, bold text and links on paper. Dark: headings and links on the dark card.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Running text, eyebrows and labels on paper. Dark: running text on the dark card.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, table captions, figure credits and post notes on paper. Dark: the small note line on the dark card.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Page folio and chart axis ticks only, at 7.5 to 9px mono. Never running text: 3.4:1 on paper.

tokens.name: meta
tokens.usage: Masthead meta line (author, date) on paper, mono 8pt. 4.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: grape
tokens.usage: The brand hue: the one accent word in a heading, stat figures, list markers, check icons, chart highlight bars, email buttons. Dark: the accent word on the dark card.

tokens.name: grape-hot
tokens.usage: Chart highlight gradient top, paired with grape.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Eyebrow on dark surfaces only (dark card, dark panel, dark post, deep blog headers).

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: The wave stroke on paper, at 1.3px; also strong hairlines.

tokens.name: hair-soft
tokens.usage: Card, callout and stats borders (0.8pt solid), table rules.

tokens.name: link-line
tokens.usage: Link underline on paper, and the top border of each flow step.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Centre of the radial grape wash behind a sheet masthead, a post and a deck title slide, fading to paper.

tokens.name: wash-2
tokens.usage: Second wash stop on carousel panels.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Band fill: the tinted strip for one key idea.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Tinted callout fill.

tokens.name: tint-line
tokens.usage: Tinted callout border.

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: Inline code fill.

tokens.name: pre
tokens.usage: Code block fill.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines.

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Screen surround behind sheet, brochure and post previews. Never printed.

tokens.name: dark-deep
tokens.usage: Darkest stop of the deck dark-slide gradient and the full-photo story fade.

tokens.name: dark-card
tokens.usage: Solid behind the cta-card image, and the middle stop of the deck dark gradient.

tokens.name: dark-high
tokens.usage: Lightest stop of the deck dark-slide gradient.

tokens.name: dark-glow
tokens.usage: Glow at the lower right of a deck dark slide, at 85% fading to 0.

tokens.name: dark-glow-2
tokens.usage: Glow at the lower left of a deck dark slide, at 85% fading to 0.

tokens.name: dark-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline between contact rows on a dark brochure panel.

tokens.name: photo-text
tokens.usage: Running text over the dark fade of a full-bleed story photo.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5.

tokens.name: header-light-1

tokens.usage: Blog header 'light' gradient, stop 2. Header ground: stop 1.

tokens.name: header-light-3
tokens.usage: Blog header 'light' gradient, stop 3. Header ground: stop 1.

tokens.name: header-light-4
tokens.usage: Blog header 'light' gradient, stop 4 (the deep accent). Header ground: stop 1.

tokens.name: header-mist-1

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.sample: How Cedar Hollow got its afternoons back
styles.usage: Sheet masthead title (34pt), max 17ch, one grape word.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section heading h2 (17pt); carries the wave opener rule.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Callout heading (12.5pt); feature card titles use 11.5pt.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Caseworkers review every draft before it is saved to the record.
styles.usage: Running text (10pt), Inter with ss01 and cv11 on.

styles.name: cta-eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrow on the dark card (9.5pt) in lilac. Sans, not mono: no mono on dark.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The label above a heading (8.5pt). Light grounds only.

tokens.name: space
tokens.usage: Paragraph and list spacing (14pt).

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its wave rule (16pt).

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading (28pt).

tokens.name: page-x
tokens.usage: Side page margin (0.75in).

tokens.name: page-top
tokens.usage: Top page margin after page one (0.8in).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code (3pt).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Email buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Callouts, feature cards, gallery images, x-small dark card (10pt).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Figures, media images, small dark card (12pt).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero image and the dark card (14pt).

shadow.note: Two stacked shadows: a wide one over a tight one read as lift; one alone reads as a smudge. One shadowed image per piece.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The standout image (.shadow), usually the hero. Baked into the pixels in print.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet or spread on the desk in screen previews. Never printed.

tokens.name: shadow-screen
tokens.usage: A product screenshot card on a blog header.
